_comment: Recorded 2026-08-13 for the same settled month 2026-07 and pseudonymised by tests/record_github_fixtures.py. The billing usage DETAIL endpoint, m6 D7's independent reconcile source, kept WHOLE at all 255 rows on purpose: the reconcile gate sums every one against the summary's own total, so a trimmed capture would not reconcile and would prove nothing. Sum of netAmount is 133.999998176, differing from the summary's by -2.842e-14 (float-summation noise, twelve orders of magnitude inside C4's absolute one-hundredth). Two properties this fixture exists to pin: the spellings disagree with the summary's and are NOT a case transform of them (copilot/Copilot Business/UserMonths here against Copilot/copilot_for_business/user-months there), and `quantity` sums to grossQuantity, never to net. It carries no timePeriod at all, which is why the period is validated before the call rather than checked after it.
